description: Create a Jack preview without saving a Post. The preview performs the normal paid model work and consumes one generation allowance, exactly like generate_post. Nothing is written to the library, so there is no Post id: to schedule or export the text afterwards, pass it as content to schedule_post or export_to_tap. Prefer generate_post when the Jack will probably be kept.

notes.description: The writer's own material for this post: their view, a voice-memo transcript or their own figures. The post is built around it.

story_id.description: The story ID to evaluate against.

name: generate_post_dry_run
